layout.reader: 100dvh stage; art starts at top. Fresh vertical mode:50% viewport-width desktop /100% below 760px. Saved preferences win.
layout.controls: 36px base rail icons; 34px desktop chapter/zoom. Phone final targets/heights 44px, chapter arrow width36px. No thumbnail drawer/bottom image counter.
layout.dialogs: Centered native settings/help and chapters follow frontmatter widths. Desktop max-height min(720px,100dvh - 48px); phone viewport -24px wide /-32px high.
layout.editor: 76px header +35px status; columns 218px/flexible/284px. At 1200px:190px/flexible/240px; at 1000px inspector floats; at 759px:one column,70px header, drawer/bottom inspector.
layout.grid: Auto-fill 148px minimum /18px gap; at 1200px minimum 140px; phone 2 columns /13px gap.
layout.metadata: One full-width title field; default-direction control removed, model unchanged.
layout.phone: Editor text inputs/selects and chapter search/source select:16px. Editor card action 42px /selection row 40px; not universally 44px.
layout.integration: Two language triggers; native top-layer edition menus. No special third-link mobile row.
layout.publication: Warm editor wrapping flex row above metadata, 10px gap, 22px bottom margin, 18px bottom padding, 1px existing rule; 44px minimum action height. Phone login inputs16px.

behavior.chrome: Three-second idle hide guarded by modal/hover/focus. Activity, center/blank contact,44px wake and tab return reveal tools.
behavior.autoScroll: Explicit play/pause in vertical mode; dialogs pause. Blur/hidden/freeze/pagehide stop; return never restarts. Reduced-motion removes decorative motion, not explicit auto-scroll.
behavior.settings: Vertical/LTR/RTL, gap 0-100px, zoom 10-200% step 5, keyboard fast/smooth step 10-200% viewport, auto 20-600px/s, progress edge/hidden, preload some/all, grayscale/dim.
behavior.persistence: Shared drafts, revisions and publication scoped by locale; existing TT remains VI. IndexedDB positions and disconnected drafts also locale-scoped; public reader ignores local drafts.
behavior.chapters: Published/missing source filters in shared mode; original sample/local filters only in disconnected prototype. Existing chapter search, ordering and 10-row pagination preserved.

provenance.source: Original built-in image_gen illustrative samples, not book originals or complete adaptation.

provenance.exclusion: Pre-existing cover/art provenance outside TT scope; no metadata repair or cover replacement.

narrative.overview:
The visitor comes to read an old Vietnamese work on a modern screen, in daylight or evening lamplight. Warm ivory paper, brown ink, vermilion controls, restrained rules, and generous margins carry the approved antique-book world. The supplied blue book cover remains the central visual artifact; its blue is image content rather than a new interface accent.

Literata gives the title and text their literary character; Be Vietnam Pro keeps controls compact and legible. Novel-Hub's familiar reading structure informs the collapsible contents rail and control bar. The edition is public, bilingual, and readable without an account; sign-in belongs to editors.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory paper, brown ink, and restrained vermilion.
Supplied blue cover; no synthetic replacement imagery.
Literata for reading and display; Be Vietnam Pro for controls.
Ruled contents, adjustable reading width, and a quiet reading column.

rules.name: The Paper and Ink Rule
rules.body: Reader surfaces, text, rules, and controls follow the active reader palette. Preserve the separate book-page dark palette.

rules.name: The Title Then Author Rule
rules.body: Keep the author immediately below the book title in normal letter spacing. Do not turn it into an eyebrow or tracked kicker.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep the reading page flat. Reserve shadows for the physical cover and temporary overlays.

rules.name: The Scoped Comic Palette Rule
rules.body: Graphite/teal/cyan belong to the local image reader. Preserve incumbent book/VI/EN values and warm editor.

dos: Do preserve the supplied cover and the approved ivory, brown, and vermilion world.
Do place the author below the book title with normal letter spacing.
Do preserve the two-row phone toolbar, grouped VI/EN control, and 40px minimum targets in the covered phone controls.
Do keep settings scrollable, keyboard focus visible, and reduced-motion handling intact.
Do let chosen reader typography and colors govern the text; distinguish defaults from preferences.
Do re-extract values when code changes and check the final applicable media rule.
Do preserve local comic final phone rules, original sample pixels and prompt provenance.
Do distinguish local drafts and the two-fix ship verdict from production approval.
donts: Don't introduce synthetic cover art or promote cover blue into a new interface palette.
Don't add decorative eyebrows, tracked author labels, or extra display faces.
Don't shrink reading text to fit a viewport or screenshot.
Don't claim a paper-fade animation that the code does not implement.
Don't infer hosted authentication, storage, or publishing verification from the locked admin screen.
Don't treat TT as a locale, invent groups/dates, restore editor default-direction, or add reader thumbnails/bottom image counters.
Don't apply the no-synthetic-cover rule to separately labelled original TT sample pages; preserve the supplied cover.
